en: It doesn't seem to be around here.
Then I'll help you look for it.
If I find it, I'll return it to you quietly.
Is this the ring you meant?
A jade ring...
It must mean a great deal to you.
Here, I'm giving it back.
Thank you. I really must
repay you somehow.
Too many eyes here, and at the barracks.
Come to my room in the barracks tonight.
Still no sign of the ring...
, I've been waiting for you.
Somehow, I want to tell you everything.
That is what's engraved inside this ring.
Elizabeth is my real name.
Why pretend to be a man?
My newborn child died,
and I resolved to join the military.
First the army, then the navy...
I just want to keep this ring, at least.
You are a strong woman, and a sad one.
Elizabeth, in his place, would you let me
kiss you?
Just for the night, forget what hurts you.
Until one day you can rise above that pain.
Master
As you command.

en: Good morning, sir.
I'm terribly sorry, but
we're still getting ready,
so please wait a little longer until we open.
My apologies, we're still getting ready,
so please wait a little longer.
Boutique Marlene will open very shortly.
Please wait just a little longer.
I'm sorry to keep you waiting.
The shop isn't open yet, you see.
Could it be,
that you came here to see me?
Of course not
That was a silly thing to say.
This is Boutique Marlene, at your service.
We make everything strictly to order.
From the finest materials, we tailor clothes
to fit you perfectly, in the latest fashion.
What sort of garment would you like?
Let me see.
Perhaps I might have a new outfit made.
We look forward to your order.
Let me see. Perhaps I might have a new
outfit made.
Happily, even this region's notables,
such as Lord Stanberg and Mr. Wesseli, are
among our clientele.
Thank you for visiting us today.
Good day, and welcome to Boutique Marlene.
May I interest you in made-to-order wear?
I think I'll order a new shirt.
Thank you very much. Then let me take your
measurements right away
Oh my, you're so tall and broad-shouldered,
you must be very popular with the ladies.
Not at all.
Oh, don't be so modest.
Then let us discuss the style of your shirt
from tomorrow onward.
I'll have a catalog prepared.
we've been expecting you.

en: If I may get straight to it, I'd like
to settle the style of the shirt
you ordered.
How about this one, with the large collar?
Yes, that will do.
This style is all the rage in Paris.
All the materials come from Paris, too.
Then I shall wait for it to be finished.
, welcome.
